email_body:
Dear Easyfairs Talent & Management Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Learning Internship at Easyfairs. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, and a strong interest in AI and emerging technologies, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to The Academy Online and help create engaging learning experiences.

In my current roles, I build and optimize websites, create digital content, and use AI tools to automate and enhance workflows. I have experience with WordPress, Canva, and video editing, and I enjoy turning complex topics into clear, accessible content. I am proactive, organized, and comfortable working independently while collaborating with international teams.

I am fluent in English and eager to learn new tools like Articulate Rise 360. I am available for an internship of at least 12 weeks and would welcome the chance to bring my creativity and technical skills to your digital learning projects.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Easyfairs.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Easyfairs Talent & Management Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Digital Learning Internship at Easyfairs. As a digital marketer with a technical background and a passion for creating engaging digital content, I am drawn to the opportunity to contribute to The Academy Online and support learning across your international organisation.

In my freelance work and my role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have built and optimized websites, created SEO-driven content, and used AI tools to streamline workflows. I have hands-on experience with WordPress, Canva, and video editing, and I enjoy transforming complex information into clear, accessible formats. For example, I designed and built a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical audits to improve search visibility. This required a good eye for structure and design, as well as attention to detail—skills I believe are essential for instructional design.

I am particularly excited about the prospect of experimenting with AI for learning and creating interactive e-learning content. While I have not yet used Articulate Rise 360, I am a quick learner and eager to master new tools. My experience with prompt engineering and MCP integrations demonstrates my ability to adapt to new technologies and apply them creatively.

I am organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks. I work well independently but also thrive in collaborative environments, as shown by my experience working with international clients and teams. I am fluent in English and available for an internship of at least 12 weeks.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my creativity and technical skills to Easyfairs and to learn from your team of learning professionals. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Digital content creation: experience with WordPress, Canva, and video editing, plus SEO writing and CMS management.

• International collaboration: worked remotely with clients and teams, fluent in English.
• Proactive and organized: freelance and junior roles demonstrate ownership and ability to manage tasks independently.
